describes: packages/plugin/signature: reads, hydration and validation, document events, fills, the sign-here target, one-shot and two-phase signing, the destination rule and the armed mark.

cases.name: reads-over-the-snapshot
cases.covers: The initial read lands the snapshot and, since something is signed, a validation of the working copy. The lists are memoized per snapshot. getSignature finds a field by ref (sameRef, which a mixed pair never matches), by name, by a widget's object number or annotation ref (a widget the snapshot doesn't carry is looked up through the form plugin), and answers null for an unknown address or an address that is neither. getVerdict follows the last validation.

cases.name: nothing-signed-reads
cases.covers: A snapshot with nothing signed lands without a validation, so getVerdict answers null from no verdicts at all.

cases.name: an-engine-without-signatures
cases.covers: Without the engine's signatures service the snapshot is null and stays idle: reads answer empty, refresh and validate answer null and [], analyzeChanges and readRevision refuse unsupported (readRevision synchronously), and every signing verb rejects unsupported. abortPending with nothing parked resolves.

cases.name: authority-twins
cases.covers: canSign needs doc.sign and a configured signer; canFill needs doc.forms.fill and an engine that draws into a signature field; canCertify needs allowCertify and doc.sign.certify. The mode defaults to sign with a signer.

cases.name: certify-needs-the-config
cases.covers: canCertify is false without allowCertify, whatever the grant; an explicit mode wins over the signer default.

cases.name: the-initial-read-fails
cases.covers: A snapshot read that rejects marks the status error and reports the initial read; a refresh rejects again.

cases.name: refresh-status-and-protection
cases.covers: The first read is loading until it lands, then ready. A protection that differs from the last snapshot's announces itself, one that is the same doesn't; a listener that throws is reported. A later read keeps the status ready while it runs.

cases.name: validate-and-the-invalidation-edge
cases.covers: validate judges the working copy by default and records the verdicts. A verdict that turns invalid because of unsaved edits warns once, on the edge (its detail, or '' without one); staying invalid doesn't warn again, and neither does a persisted basis. `at` and `until` pass through; validateField answers one field's verdict or rejects not-found.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: no signed field at that address

cases.name: revisions-and-analysis
cases.covers: analyzeChanges asks the engine; readRevision reads a revision by index or a signed field's revision, and rejects not-found for an unsigned field or a signature sealing no whole revision.

modifications.detail: the signature seals no whole revision

$error.message: no signed revision at that address

cases.name: document-events
cases.covers: A parked, aborted or completed signing sets and clears the pending signing. A new version or a desync re-reads and re-judges; a change of the field set re-reads and re-judges soon; an edit of the working copy re-judges soon, coalesced into one validation 300 ms after the last edit. Other events are ignored.

cases.name: nothing-signed-is-never-re-judged
cases.covers: An edit with nothing signed schedules no validation.

cases.name: background-failures-are-reported
cases.covers: A re-read after a new version or a field-set change that fails is reported, as is a scheduled validation that fails.

cases.name: close-drops-the-pending-validation
cases.covers: Closing the document with a validation scheduled clears its timer and disposes the hooks.

cases.name: fill-and-clear
cases.covers: fillField draws the mark's bytes into the field, re-reads the form, clears the field as the sign-here target and announces the fill, busy while it runs. clearField draws the blank page. A signed field refuses conflict; an unknown asset mark refuses not-found without the stamp plugin.

cases.name: fill-without-an-engine-door
cases.covers: An engine that cannot draw into a signature field refuses unsupported.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: this engine cannot draw into a signature field

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: this engine cannot draw into a signature field

cases.name: the-sign-here-target
cases.covers: setTarget announces a new target; the same ref again, or null again, is no change; a name and an object number never match each other, two names match by name. A fill of another field keeps the target. requestInspection announces the field.

cases.name: fill-an-asset-mark
cases.covers: A mark naming a stamp asset draws the asset's bytes; an asset the stamp plugin doesn't know refuses not-found.

cases.name: two-phase-signing
cases.covers: prepareSignature parks the signing (pending, with the appearance when a mark or appearance is given) and hands out the digest. completeSignature of a signing this session did not prepare rejects not-found; of the parked one it completes against the prepared version, clears the pending signing and the target, re-reads, re-judges and announces the signature.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: no signing 'unknown' was prepared in this session

cases.name: abort-the-parked-signing
cases.covers: abortPending cancels the parked signing and clears it; with nothing parked it does nothing.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: no signing 'signing-1' was prepared in this session

cases.name: a-parked-signing-from-elsewhere
cases.covers: abortPending cancels a signing the engine announced, which this session can't complete.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: no signing 'remote-1' was prepared in this session

cases.name: sign-one-shot
cases.covers: sign resolves the configured signer, prepares with the mark as the appearance and the caller's attribution, has a CMS signer answer, passes the completion gate and completes; then it clears the target, re-reads, starts a validation and announces the signature.

cases.name: sign-with-a-per-call-signer
cases.covers: A per-call signer wins over the configured one, and a function resolves the signer first. An explicit appearance wins over the mark. A validation after signing that fails is reported.

cases.name: sign-with-a-raw-signer
cases.covers: A raw signer's certificate subject is the default /Name, which the caller's attribution overrides; a signer that fails aborts the signing and rejects. A thunk signer resolves per signing. A raw signer with no certificate names no one.

cases.name: sign-without-a-signer
cases.covers: sign with no signer configured or passed rejects invalid-input; a mark the stamp plugin can't resolve rejects not-found.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: no signer: configure `signer` or pass one with the call (mode "sign" needs one)

cases.name: place-by-mode-visual
cases.covers: Mode visual fills the field; a free placement of an asset goes through the stamp plugin and of bytes through the annotation plugin.

cases.name: place-by-mode-ask
cases.covers: Mode ask hands the field and the mark to the chrome.

cases.name: place-an-asset-without-the-stamp-plugin
cases.covers: A free placement of an asset with no stamp plugin refuses unsupported.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: no stamp plugin to place an asset

cases.name: place-by-mode-sign-offers-certification
cases.covers: Mode sign with allowCertify and nothing signed yet asks the chrome (the first signature can certify) instead of sealing.

cases.name: place-by-mode-sign-seals
cases.covers: Mode sign seals the field, even with allowCertify once something is signed.

cases.name: an-armed-mark-over-a-field
cases.covers: With the interaction hub and the stamp plugin, an armed asset from a signatures library pressed over an empty signature field disarms and goes into the field by mode. Over a signed field, or a signature field that carries a value, the press is consumed and nothing happens. Over a text field, over no field, or without a page the handler declines and the annotation plugin's stamp placement runs.

cases.name: an-armed-stamp-is-not-a-mark
cases.covers: An asset from a library of another kind, or a stamp the annotation plugin armed on its own, is not a person's mark: the handler declines. With another tool active the handler is not asked.

cases.name: a-mark-that-fails-to-land
cases.covers: A placement the handler started that rejects is reported.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: this engine cannot draw into a signature field

cases.name: no-handler-without-the-hub-and-the-stamp-plugin
cases.covers: Without the stamp plugin no handler is registered, so an armed stamp over a field stays a stamp placement.

cases.name: the-capability-shape
cases.covers: createSignatureCapability subscribes to document events but reads nothing until asked.

cases.name: the-controller-shape
cases.covers: createSignatureController with no config connects the same way the plugin does, without the armed-mark handler.
